lin: Quick postmortem note: onboarding magnet13b-int4-lite hit a reproducible long-prefill drift after snapshot s-2026-08-11-compactprefill. Short reproducer and observations below.

noah: TL;DR numbers?

lin: On our 8k anchor set top-5 recall drops 0.884 -> 0.859 (delta 0.025) only when resuming KV from snapshot. Cold-start and short prompts unaffected.

priya: Which changes landed in that snapshot?

lin: Twofold: 1) snapshot-time "compact_rotary" normalization to shrink metadata, 2) reduced `kvcache_write_grain` from 64 -> 32. Both in the same roll.

noah: Can you paste a tiny repro command? I'll try on my dev box.

lin: Repro (use image rwinf/dev:canary):
```
python eval/long_anchor.py --model magnet13b-int4-lite --snapshot s-2026-08-11-compactprefill --prompt tests/anchors/long-08.txt --max-tokens 8192 --kvcache-mode resume --quant-kernel int4 --emit-json
```
Baseline top5: 0.884, canary: 0.859. Quick logs: LOGIT_SUMMARY {"compact_rotary_tail": 0.0029, "grain_boundary_skew": 0.0013}.

priya: Try `--disable-compact-rotary` or bump `--kvcache-write-grain 64`?

lin: Ran both on a canary node: disable compact -> 0.882, grain=64 -> 0.879, both -> 0.883. So both knobs largely recover.

noah: That screams numeric interaction: compacting reduces FP headroom and smaller write grain changes accumulation ordering in int4 path leading to rare but impactful phase slips.

ops-bot: Canary s-2026-08-11-compactprefill deployed to 3% at 2026-08-11T02:10:00Z. Metric flagged: longctx_top5_drop=0.025.

priya: Proposed next steps: 1) add a pre-commit snapshot check that rehydrates a short long-prefill trace and computes per-token phase delta histogram; block commit if tail > 1e-3. 2) store `rotary_scale`/`phase_norm` in fp32 in snapshot metadata (low-lift). 3) add a deterministic cross-grain stitch rule in kvcache writer so accumulation order is stable.

noah: I'll prototype the preflight rehydrate-check and a unit that simulates cross-grain accumulation for int4 kernels. If we confirm accumulation-order sensitivity we can either enforce deterministic order or keep grain conservative.

qa-bot: Queued regression job `longprefill-compactrotary-smoke` x3: https://ci.redwood-internal/longprefill/2965432100

lin: I'm going to pause broader canary ramp until we have either fp32 snapshot metadata or the preflight gate. Adding note to model onboarding checklist.

priya: Also adding a nightly job to run the rehydrate-check on every new snapshot and attach histogram to snapshot artifacts so rollouts fail fast if the tail grows.

noah: Nice. Thanks all. One more: keep snapshot IDs boring. :stuck_out_tongue:
